KingPepe Native → 🔥 Burn → Solana KPEPE

KingPepe (KPEPE) was originally launched on June 13, 2025 as a native SHA-256 Proof-of-Work cryptocurrency. KPEPE originates from its own blockchain, where coins are issued through real SHA-256 mining by miners and mining hardware, with a maximum supply of 21,000,000 KPEPE.
As the project evolved, KingPepe introduced a Native-to-Solana bridge to bring KPEPE into the Solana ecosystem without creating additional economic supply. KPEPE on Solana is the official 1:1 representation of Native KingPepe. For every KPEPE minted on Solana through the bridge, the equivalent amount of Native KPEPE is permanently burned on the original KingPepe blockchain.
This burn-and-mint mechanism preserves the 1:1 relationship between the original mined asset and its Solana representation, connecting KingPepe's SHA-256 mining origins with the Solana ecosystem.
